events.subtitle: Featuring PUBLIQuartet — A Celebration of the Music of Chick Corea and Beyond
events.category: Living masters / Japan / Chick Corea legacy
events.factual_description: Strathmore presents Stanley Clarke and Hiromi featuring PUBLIQuartet on Thursday, April 8, 2027 at 8:00 PM in The Music Center at Strathmore. The program is billed as A Celebration of the Music of Chick Corea and Beyond, combining Corea compositions with new works inspired by his legacy. Strathmore highlights Clarke's long collaboration with Corea in Return to Forever, Hiromi's formative connection with Corea beginning when he invited her to perform with him in Tokyo at age 17, and PUBLIQuartet's blend of classical performance, improvisation and global influences.

en.why_it_matters: This is an unusually dense Listening Notes intersection: Stanley Clarke, one of fusion's defining bass voices and Chick Corea's Return to Forever partner, meets Hiromi, whose own relationship with Corea began in Tokyo, with PUBLIQuartet adding a chamber-improvisational layer. It is not a generic tribute but a meeting of two generations with direct musical relationships to Corea and sharply different instrumental identities.
en.trip_verdict: S+ in the DMV. Protect the night. The Clarke–Hiromi pairing, direct Chick Corea lineage and string-quartet setting make this rare enough to justify a dedicated regional trip to North Bethesda.

es.why_it_matters: Esta fecha concentra de manera extraordinaria varios ejes de Listening Notes: Stanley Clarke, una de las voces definitorias del bajo en la fusión y socio de Chick Corea en Return to Forever, se encuentra con Hiromi, cuya propia relación con Corea comenzó en Tokio, mientras PUBLIQuartet añade una capa camerística e improvisatoria. No es un homenaje genérico, sino el encuentro de dos generaciones con vínculos musicales directos con Corea e identidades instrumentales muy distintas.
es.trip_verdict: S+ en el DMV. Hay que proteger la noche. La combinación Clarke–Hiromi, el linaje directo de Chick Corea y el formato con cuarteto de cuerdas la vuelven suficientemente rara para justificar un viaje regional dedicado a North Bethesda.
